saves.title: Saved single-player games
saves.name: Save name (optional)
saves.explanation: These saves contain the running simulation, resources, ownership and AI state. They are separate from settings and course progress. Loading continues a single-player game; it does not enter public rankings.
saves.compatibility: Continue with the same game build. Export an important save before deleting it or clearing browser data. If a save cannot be read or is incompatible, keep the file and use a compatible build. Failed operations do not confirm success.
saves.exported: Save export requested. Check your browser's downloads.
saves.confirm_delete: Delete saved game “{name}”? Export it first if you want to keep a copy.
saves.empty: No saved games yet. Save during a single-player match or import a compatible file.
saves.failed_short: Save failed. Open this panel for recovery details.
saves.error: The save operation failed. Check storage space, file format and game build. Your existing saves remain available.
